_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A failed pending relay still ends the call after automatic stop. The voice call is faked. In an eval, window.liveEmit(event) delivers event from Live (e.g. window.liveEmit({type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Hello ", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 400})); emit each event in its own eval, in the order given. window.liveSpeak(id, speech) speaks and delegates: it emits {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: speech, start_ms: 0, end_ms: 900} and then {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 900, delegation: {id, target: "client"}}. window.liveNotes() returns the JSON of everything Shelley sent to Live. window.__voiceTracksStopped counts the microphone tracks stopped. "Start the call" means: click data-testid "live-call-header"; data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call". "The exchange" is data-testid "live-exchange". "The message X" is the [data-testid="message"] elements whose text contains X (has_text; it collapses whitespace, so a line break is a space). Text checks on messages and the exchange compare whitespace-collapsed text: eval el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").includes(...) with expect true (or false for "not contain"), on every matching element. Once call "intercept" has run, the server's answer to every relay of events (POST .../live-session/<session>/events) is held back until call "release" and is then 503 "Relay failed for test"; call "held" says whether one is being held. Call "hangup" says how the server answered the first hangup (DELETE .../live-session/<session>): "ok" for success. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/relay and start the call.
2. Call "intercept". Emit {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Already received words", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 1000}. Call "held" should come to return exactly "true".
3. Call "release" (without hanging up).
4. Call "hangup" should return exactly "ok". data-testid "live-error" should contain "Failed to relay the call to Shelley" and "Relay failed for test". There should be no data-testid "live-stop" (count 0), and window.__voiceTracksStopped should be greater than 0 (eval, expect true).

steps.expression: window.liveEmit({type: 'session.input_transcript.delta', delta: 'Already received words', start_ms: 0, end_ms: 1000})
document.querySelector('[data-testid="live-error"]').textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').includes('Failed to relay the call to Shelley')
